newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE seeks 12-16 percent return on equity.
newsitem.headline: RWE seeks 12-16 percent return on equity.

text.p: German diversified energy group RWE AG said on Thursday it was targeting a return on equity of between 12 and 16 percent for its various business sectors.

RWE said the target would also hold good for recent acquisitions, with allowances for risk. In the year to the end of June 1996, RWE's total return on equity was 11 percent, while average capital costs were 10 percent.
The group's good liquidity, due to large reserves, could only be invested at low bond yields.
The group had returns of 13 percent in the operating area, management board chairman Dietmar Kuhnt said.
